note: v2518: v2516 made the spy defensive so a conversion failure could not break the census, and nothing then handled the None it produces. A cold review traced all three: a None sources makes the assertion fail claiming the sources were empty, a None pool fails identically to an empty pool, and a None reach makes set(None) raise TypeError and crash the test. A failure of the instrument reported as a defect in the code under test. The snapshot is asserted non-None before anything reads its contents now, with a message naming the spy as the thing that failed.
